Why go: a classic Lagoon catamaran with transfers on most trips

Blue Coco is a Lagoon 400, one of the most popular cruising catamarans in the world: stable, roomy and with cabins and bathrooms below. It is a well-priced way to charter a real sailing catamaran on Koh Samui, and the half-day, sunset and Koh Phangan trips include the van from your hotel.

What you'll do

Short trips go to Koh Som off Samui's north-east tip for swimming, snorkelling and paddle boarding, or leave Phetcharat pier at 16:30 for a 2-hour sunset with a swim at Koh Som. The full day near Samui gives you 8 hours to anchor in quiet bays. The Koh Phangan day stops at Haad Yuan or Koh Ma for snorkelling and a beach restaurant for lunch. From 16 December the longest trip sails to Ang Thong Marine Park for the Thale Nai lagoon and beach time.

Who it suits

  • Families and groups of 6–10 who want sailing, not speed.
  • First-time sailors: the morning trip to Koh Som is short and gentle.
  • Groups up to 25 at a modest extra-guest price.

Who should choose something else

  • Groups heading to Ang Thong on a tight schedule: a private speedboat to Ang Thong takes about an hour each way.
  • Couples wanting everything included: Siam Seas Explorer.

Good to know

  • Menu: order food and drinks in advance so the crew can prepare.
  • Wind: the crew raises the sails when there is enough wind and uses the engines when it is light.
  • Ang Thong: closed from 1 November to 15 December.

Before you book

Choose your trip and tell us your group size and hotel. Let us know if you want lunch or drinks from the on-board menu, so the crew can prepare. For the Ang Thong day we add the van if needed and confirm the 08:30 start.
